plugin.note: Monkeys are combat level 3 with 6 Hitpoints and no defensive bonuses; any weapon kills them in one or two hits. The Karamja monkey clusters are the quickest place to complete the task.

requirements: There is no combat or Slayer level requirement to be assigned Monkeys.
Only regular monkeys count; Maniacal monkeys and the Ape Atoll bosses do not.
mechanics: Monkey: combat level 3, 6 Hitpoints, max hit 1 (crush), 4-tick attack speed, Defence level 2 with no bonuses.
Monkeys are practically defenceless and are not undead, so the salve amulet does not apply.
No elemental weakness is documented; any combat style works.
Maniacal monkeys and the Monkey Madness bosses are excluded from the task.

methods.label: Any melee weapon
methods.summary: Kill common monkeys on Karamja with any melee weapon; they die in one or two hits.
steps: Travel to Karamja (south-east of Musa Point, or around Brimhaven).
Attack the monkeys with any weapon; their 6 Hitpoints and zero Defence bonuses make kills instant.
Ape Atoll and Mos Le'Harmless monkeys also count.
notes: Avoid Maniacal monkeys, which are a separate monster and do not count.

methods.label: Ranged or Magic
methods.summary: Use Ranged or Magic to clear monkeys while training those skills.
requiredOrKeyItems: A ranged weapon and ammunition, or spell runes
steps: Travel to a dense Karamja monkey spawn.
Attack from range; the monkeys' 6 Hitpoints make kills near-instant.
Pick up bones and drops if desired.
notes: Any style works given the monkeys' complete lack of defensive bonuses.
